stem: A 15-year-old is increasingly working out personal values, autonomy, and responsibility rather than simply copying family views; which developmental task domain is most directly illustrated?
explanation: Moral and ethical development is the correct answer. It involves forming personal values, autonomy, and responsibility, which best matches the adolescent described in the stem.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because physical and biological development mainly refers to puberty and sexual maturation.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because cognitive development mainly involves abstract thinking, problem-solving, and future planning.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because emotional development involves identity formation and emotion regulation, but the stem is more directly about values and responsibility.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because social development mainly involves peer relationships, intimacy, separation from parents, and role experimentation.
optionExplanations.E: Correct because moral and ethical development involves forming personal values, autonomy, and responsibility rather than simply adopting family views.
